Perfect for awkward first dates, middle school crushes, or passive-aggressive office Valentine's Day exchanges. Just don't blame us if they choke on 'Call Me.'

title: Sour Then Spicy Regret
tagline: For when you want to confuse your taste buds, try these chili coated Sour Patch gummies. Imagine eating a Sour Patch kid while accidentally brushing against a spicy food festival - that's what these are.

title: Galactic Goodies for the Cosmic Cocoa Lover
tagline: When your kid's science project requires a snackable solar system, these chocolate planets are your ticket to interstellar indulgence. Perfect for the astronomy enthusiast who also enjoys a midnight snack. Just don't blame us if they start asking for a chocolate moon next.

title: Reaper of Snack Souls
tagline: For when you want to cry during a movie, but not because of the plot. This Carolina Reaper popcorn is perfect for that one friend who thinks they can handle the heat.

title: Frostbite Cupcake Decor
tagline: Because nothing says 'I care' like a cupcake that looks like it survived a polar expedition. Perfect for the office party where the thermostat is set to 'arctic' and your coworkers need a reminder that yes, it is, in fact, still winter. Comes in a pack of 12, so you can frostbite all your friends.

title: Pizza, But Chewable
tagline: For when you're craving pizza but your oven is broken—or, more likely, when you're too lazy to heat up a frozen one. These gummy slices are the perfect snack for a 'movie night' that consists of you, a blanket fort, and a questionable life choice. Just don't blame us if you start expecting your real pizza to be this bouncy.

title: Thin Mint Alchemy
tagline: For the baker who’s tired of ‘just’ making cookies—now you can make *the* cookies. Perfect for when your local troop’s annual sale coincides with your existential dread. Includes a ‘Do Not Disturb’ sign for the oven door, because Thin Mints aren’t just baked, they’re *earned*.

title: Spice Roulette Monthly
tagline: For the friend who insists their tolerance is 'mildly spicy' but still cries over jalapeños. Each box is a gamble—will it be a smoky habanero or a ghost pepper that sends them running to the bathroom? Perfect for dinner parties where you need to thin the guest list.

title: Champagne for People Who Forgot to Buy Wine
tagline: When your dinner party guests are already three glasses deep and you realize you forgot to buy champagne, this blue-hued imposter swoops in to save the night. Perfect for toasting with your 'I survived 2020' Zoom reunion or when you want your Instagram brunch to look like it’s happening on a spaceship. Just don’t ask what makes it blue.

title: Walter's Kitchen Sin
tagline: For when you want to cook like a meth kingpin, but only have a toaster oven. This cookbook is perfect for that one friend who still quotes Heisenberg at parties.

title: Liquid Butter: The Apocolypse?
tagline: So, you've decided to fully embrace the end times, huh? Look, we get it. Society's crumbling. Might as well mainline the essence of movie theater popcorn topping. Perfect for when you're too lazy to melt actual butter on your microwaved potato. Or, you know, just chug it straight from the bottle while contemplating your life choices. We're not judging. Mostly because we already ordered three cases.

title: Shroom Boom in a Box
tagline: For the urban forager who’s tired of pretending to like store-bought mushrooms. This kit lets you grow your own shiitakes in the comfort of your bathroom—because who needs a shower when you can have a mini forest? Perfect for the college student who wants to impress their vegan roommate or the suburbanite who’s one step away from building a yurt in their backyard.

title: Global Cocoa Tour (In Your Mouth)
tagline: For the armchair traveler who’s too lazy to leave their couch but still wants to feel culturally enriched. This box lets you taste chocolate from places you’ll never visit—like a Belgian waffle without the waffle. Perfect for when your date asks about your ‘worldly experiences’ and you just want to hand them a bar of Peruvian dark chocolate instead.

title: Fungal Farming for the Lazy
tagline: Forget watering plants—just inoculate a log and let the mushrooms do the work. Perfect for the urban forager who wants to impress their dinner guests with 'wild' ingredients, or the survivalist who thinks a zombie apocalypse will be delayed by a few weeks while their shiitakes grow.

title: Fluffy Dog Marshies
tagline: Because your tea needs a Shiba face, these marshmallows bring canine charm to your sad, solo camping trips.

title: Pizza Cone? Pizza Problem Solved.
tagline: Forget pizza parties—host a pizza *conga line*. This maker turns your pie into a handheld, mess-free snack, perfect for the office lunch where you’re too busy pretending to work to use a fork. Now you can eat pizza like a taco, which is basically how adults eat pizza anyway.

title: Skewered Sugar Shenanigans
tagline: Because nothing says 'I care' like impaling your loved one's favorite candy on a stick. Perfect for the office party where someone inevitably asks, 'Is this a salad?' while reaching for a gummy bear. Comes with 100 skewers and a sense of dread about your next dentist visit.

title: Sugar, But Make It Rude?

title: Oreo Truffles: The Cookie Monster's Regret

Perfect for your coworker who brings in 'homemade' treats that are suspiciously similar to store-bought. title: Kitty's Midnight Snack Attack
tagline: For when your midnight sugar cravings demand a side of existential crisis. These Hello Kitty cookies aren't just for kids—they're for the adult who still keeps a plushie on their desk. Perfect for that 3 AM work break where you question life choices while nibbling on a cookie that stares back at you.

title: Cheesecake Roulette
tagline: For when your dinner party needs a twist—literally. Imagine your guest's face when they bite into what they think is a normal cheesecake, only to be hit with a salty-sweet tsunami. Perfect for the friend who claims they 'don't like surprises' but secretly thrives on them. Just don't blame us if they start questioning all their life choices.

title: Fungi Fuel
tagline: Because your morning routine was missing a hint of damp forest floor, this mushroom coffee is perfect for when you want to confuse your taste buds and impress your hipster friends.

title: Pizza for the Pregnant
tagline: Because nothing says 'congratulations on your impending existential crisis' like a registry that lets Aunt Karen gift you a large pepperoni instead of a onesie. Perfect for the expecting parent who wants to ensure their child’s first memory is of their parents arguing over who ate the last slice.

title: Han Solo’s Sugar Rush

Perfect for the Star Wars fan who’s also a ‘I’ll have the chocolate, hold the guilt’ kind of rebel. Just don’t try to outrun the sugar crash.

title: Sweat & Regret Starter Pack
tagline: For when your friend claims they can handle 'a little heat'—then spends the next hour alternating between chugging milk and Googling 'why does my face feel like lava?' This crate is your revenge. Includes everything from 'mildly uncomfortable' to 'call an ambulance' spice levels. Perfect for that office potluck where you want to be remembered as the one who brought the apocalypse in a box.

Just pop the tab, sip, and pretend you’re at a fancy rooftop bar. Bonus: No one will judge your mixing skills—or lack thereof.

Just a *smidge* will guarantee victory, albeit one that requires paramedics and a signed waiver from all attendees. Use responsibly...or don't. We're not your therapist.

Perfect for toasting to the fact that you've finally convinced your cat to wear a sombrero.

title: Veggie Roulette Seeds

Pair with a fancy cheese board to really sell the illusion.

This fancy fermentation system is like a five-star hotel for yeast—temperature-controlled, pressure-regulated, and with a built-in spa (aka the bubbler). Perfect for when you want to impress your friends with a ‘craft’ IPA that doesn’t taste like it was brewed in a bathtub.

title: Purr-fectly Odd Snacks

title: Kit Kat Cake Conspiracy

Includes everything but the existential crisis when you realize you're making cheese in a cubicle.

tagline: For the friend who's had one too many gas station hot dogs, this gift box of exotic jerky and sausage is a questionable life choice that might just pay off at your next camping trip gone wrong.

title: Pancake Party In A Box
tagline: Because your Sunday brunch needed a sugar coma, this kit makes rainbow pancakes. Imagine serving these to your hungover friends after a rave.

title: Cookie Cheesecake Chaos
tagline: For when you're too lazy to choose between Oreos and cheesecake, these cookies exist. Imagine eating a whole dessert buffet in one awkward bite at your aunt's potluck.

title: Island Sugar Coma
tagline: Stuck in a meeting with a coworker from Puerto Rico? Send a candy box to break the ice, or induce a sugar crash that'll get you both excused early.

title: May the Crumbs Be
tagline: For that one aunt who still throws Star Wars marathons, these cookie cutters will make her galaxy-themed sugar cookies slightly less embarrassing to serve.

title: Sugarcoated Mortality
tagline: For the friend who loves chocolate and existential dread, these mini skulls are perfect for a dinner party where you want to casually mention your will.

title: Espresso for the Discerning
tagline: For when you want to impress your date with a manually levered espresso, because nothing says 'I'm interested' like a little arm workout and a shot of coffee.

title: The Glutton’s Delight
tagline: For those moments when you're staring at the ice cream truck with two kids, a spouse, and a sudden urge to prove you're still the family's MVP. This double-scoop cone lets you hold two flavors at once, because why settle for vanilla when you can also have chocolate? Just don't blame us when your hands get sticky and your dignity gets lost in the process.

title: Citrus Savior Tool
tagline: For that one aunt who insists on bringing her famous marmalade to family gatherings, this 2-in-1 peeler and zester is a must. It's the perfect excuse to spend an afternoon zesting oranges in your pajamas.

title: Shake Your Wallet
tagline: Treat yourself to a $100 milkshake after a bad investment, because what's another poor life choice?

title: Feast Like A Lannister
tagline: Because your dinner parties need more backstabbing, serve dishes from the Seven Kingdoms. Impress friends with a Sansa-approved lemon cake, or poison them with a mysterious pie.

title: Hangry Apocalypse Kit
tagline: For when you're stuck in a meeting that's dragging on longer than your sanity, this snack box saves you from devouring the conference table.

title: Cake for Science Experiments
tagline: For the friend who insists on baking during D&D nights, this cake mix is a surprisingly sane choice, considering the chaos that ensues when they try to 'improve' the recipe with questionable ingredients.

title: Nutella Overload Alert
tagline: For when you need a chocolate-hazelnut intervention, this combo saves you a trip to the store... and your dignity.

title: Snackstick Sophistication
tagline: For when you need to impress your book club but also maintain the ability to stab someone with your snack. These chocolate-dipped pretzel rods are the perfect blend of elegance and menace. Ideal for passive-aggressive office meetings or when you want to serve dessert like a medieval knight.

title: Cocktails in the Wild
tagline: For when you need a gin martini in the middle of nowhere, because hiking isn't civilized without one.

title: Brain Juice Alert
tagline: For when you need a drink to compensate for skipping breakfast, lunch, and a decent night's sleep. TruBrain's nootropic drinks to the rescue, because adulting is hard.

title: Freeze Your Folgers
tagline: For those who prefer their caffeine with a side of frostbite. Perfect for the office worker who wants to impress their boss by bringing in 'homemade' cold brew that's been steeping in the break room fridge since last Tuesday. Includes a stylish carafe that doubles as a science experiment display.

title: Bake, Eat, Repeat
tagline: For when you want to impress your stoner friends with 'gourmet' brownies at 3 AM, this cookbook has you covered.

title: Sriracha On Everything
tagline: For the friend who puts Sriracha on their scrambled eggs, and also their toast, and probably their cat. This cookbook is a judgment-free zone, with recipes to match their questionable life choices.

title: Indoor S'mores? Brave Choice.
tagline: For when you need the taste of campfire-induced existential dread, but the HOA frowns on open flames. Perfect for crafting a melancholic s'more while watching nature documentaries about bears that have better access to the outdoors than you do. Marshmallow flambé without the firewood.

title: Caffeine On A Stick
tagline: For those mornings when pouring coffee is too much effort, these stir sticks save the day. Literally, just stir and go, because adulting is hard.

title: Pineapple Ninja Tool
tagline: For that one aunt who insists on bringing a fresh pineapple to the family reunion, this slicer is a must. It's the perfect way to avoid her judgmental looks when you struggle to cut the thing.

title: Sloth Sauce for Chill
tagline: For when you need a hot sauce that's as laid-back as you are after a CBD binge, this sloth-approved concoction brings the heat without the anxiety of actually doing anything productive.

title: Marshmallow Madness Ensues (Lucky Charms)
tagline: Because adulting is hard, treat yourself to Lucky Charms ice cream after a 3am cereal binge didn't quite hit the spot.

title: Fruit Loop Madness Ensues
tagline: For the 3am craving when you need to turn last week's freezer burn into a vaguely healthy dessert, this thing's a lifesaver. Or at least a sleep-deprived sanity saver.

title: Peanut Butter Coma Cup
tagline: For when you need a chocolate-induced hug after eating an entire pizza by yourself, this cup is the answer. It's like a warm blanket, but edible and slightly judgmental.

title: Soul Crusher Pepper
tagline: For that one friend who thinks they can handle the heat, serve this at your next dinner party and watch as they desperately reach for a glass of milk, questioning every life choice that led them to this moment.

title: Brew-tiful Overkill
tagline: For the coffee connoisseur who's obsessed with precision, this $129.99 refining system is a must. Imagine arguing with your roommate over grind consistency at 6am – this gadget ends that war.

title: Food in a Cube
tagline: For when you want to eat like an astronaut, but your space mission is actually just a desk job, SquarEat's got you covered with meal blocks that are out of this world, yet oddly familiar.

title: Spoon For The Lazy
tagline: Because twisting apart Oreos with your fingers is so last season, this spoon lets you dunk in style, or at least without getting cream on your shirt during late-night snacking binges.

title: Whisky For The Bearded
tagline: When you're alone, bearded, and questioning life choices, Nick Offerman's Lagavulin whisky is there to numb the pain of adulting.

title: Mystery Cuban Snack Attack
tagline: Stuck in a meeting that's dragging on? Send a Cuban Goodies box to the conference room and watch as coworkers fight over plantain chips and guava paste.

title: Sandwich Your Sorrows
tagline: For when you need a cookie, ice cream, and a therapy session in one, this maker is here to enable your emotional eating with neatly packaged ice cream sandwiches.

title: Tea That Judges You
tagline: For when you want to impress your in-laws with a flower that blooms in your tea, silently criticizing your life choices as it unfurls.

title: Habanero Hellfire: Taste the Burn
tagline: So, your in-laws are visiting. Again. And they *insist* on mild salsa. This might be your subtle, fiery solution. Just a whisper of Dr. Assburn's Habanero Hellfire will transform that bland tomato concoction into something... memorable. Just be sure to have the antacids ready, for them. And maybe a fire extinguisher, for you.

title: Bacon's Personal Sunbed
tagline: For when you need to grill 12 strips of bacon simultaneously, because your brunch party is judging you and your mediocre BLT assembly line.

title: Liquid Lunch of Despair
tagline: For when you're too busy to chew, but still want to question life choices, Soylent's got you covered. Imagine sipping dinner on a solo road trip to nowhere, and this drink makes perfect sense.
